title: Light Saudi Arabian Pineapple Pasta
description: A cultured and romantic Saudi Arabian dish featuring pineapple juice and a low sodium pasta water emulsion, served on a beautiful talavera plate
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions
In a small bowl, whisk together the pineapple juice, olive oil, garlic, ginger, salt free seasoning, and black pepper
Once the pasta is cooked, drain it and return it to the pot, adding the pineapple juice mixture and tossing to combine
Reduce heat to low and simmer the pasta mixture for 2 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld
Stir in the chopped parsley and cook for an additional minute
Serve the pasta hot on a talavera plate, garnished with additional parsley if desired
